summary: Iteration 2 (multi-pair mapping + async compare). Backend: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py updated for new pairs[] model + async compare polling; 8/8 tests pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright on public URL: login, business detail with demo mapping showing 2 DC↔DR pairs + dc-lb-01/dc-lb-02 hosts, MappingDialog dynamic pair rows (add-pair-btn, pair-dc-node-i, pair-dr-node-i, remove-pair-i with min 1 enforced), create/edit/delete flows, Run Compare returns immediately + navigates to Run Detail showing 'run-running' banner and polls until failed with per-pair error, seeded drift Run Detail shows MOCKED Freshdesk banner + pair-tab-0/1 selector + summary chips + filters + unified diff (worker_connections visible for nginx.conf), /runs listing shows '1/2' drifted info, Incidents page shows MOCKED tag, logout + auth guard both enforced.

minor.issue: Idempotent by name check but subsequent calls return an existing-marker payload — behavior is now idempotent (unchanged since iter 1; verified).
Status is a query param (?status=...) rather than JSON body — unusual REST style, but now validates against {open,resolved,closed} and returns 400 otherwise (verified).

issues: Card is not itself clickable — only the tiny 'Manage →' link navigates to the business detail. Whole card should probably be a click target for better UX.

action_items: (Optional UX) Make the entire Business card on /businesses navigate to the detail page (currently only 'Manage →' link works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/node-pairs correctly rejects empty pairs list with 400 — good.

comparison.start_comparison launches asyncio.create_task without awaiting; run is persisted first, so if the process restarts mid-run the run stays in 'running' forever (no watchdog). Consider a stuck-run reaper or timestamp-based timeout.
comparison._compare_mapping_sync runs pairs sequentially inside asyncio.to_thread — for many pairs this could be slow. Consider parallelizing per-pair SSH via ThreadPoolExecutor.
server.py GET /api/runs strips 'pairs' via projection {'pairs':0} — good for listing perf.
clean_node_pair strips ssh_password_enc + _id and adds has_credentials — good; no secret leakage confirmed via tests.
RunDetail.jsx polling uses setTimeout with cancelled flag — clean; but if the run stays 'running' forever (backend crash mid-run) the UI polls indefinitely — see backend reaper suggestion above.
BusinessDetail MappingDialog: removePair uses array index as key which can cause stale input state on removal of middle rows (React key warning). Prefer a stable per-row id.
server.py is ~344 lines — still fine; below the 700 line threshold.
seed_data_creation: Demo already seeded from iter 1; re-invoked /api/demo/seed which now returns already_seeded marker. Test created + deleted TEST_UI_Mapping (2 pairs) as part of the flow.
